description: Download a directory from a sandbox as a ZIP archive, returned base64-encoded in the result's structured content (symlinks are skipped). Use this to pull a whole folder — build output, results, a small project — in one call. Directories that zip to more than 10 MiB are rejected: grab a subdirectory, pull individual files with sandbox_files_read, or use the Superserve SDK/CLI for the full archive.

path.description: Absolute directory path to download, e.g. "/app/output".

name: sandbox_files_download_dir
title: Download a directory as a zip
